The following events took place in '''26 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Salak Weet]] and his friend [[Noa Briqualon]] went missing on their [[Noa Briqualon's starship|starship's]] maiden voyage near the [[Monsua Nebula/Legends|Monsua Nebula]].<ref name="Hnn-Missing Starship Search Abandoned">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|regional/13328_2.html|Missing Starship Search Abandoned}}</ref>
*[[Yeorg Captison]] is elected to the [[Bakuran Senate]].
*[[Maxo Vista]] wins the [[Galactic Games/Legends|Galactic Games]].
*[[Cestus Cybernetics]] ends a mining union strikes using killer [[Droid/Legends|droids]].
*[[Yaddle/Legends|Yaddle]] is killed.
*[[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] joins the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]], replacing Yaddle.
*[[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker Lars]] is sold by [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] to,<ref name="UVG">''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> and freed from [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] by, [[Cliegg Lars/Legends|Cliegg Lars]].
